title: reserve
description: Capacity items (rooms, seats, bays, shifts): book or cancel over one interval or a repeating pattern, or read free windows + utilization (op availability). Stock counts are manage_stock's.

op.description: book (409 on a clash or outside offered hours) | cancel | availability (free windows and utilization over from/to). Default book.

start.description: book/cancel: ISO-8601 start (naive = UTC). With rule, the first occurrence's start. Required except cancel-by-source.

end.description: book/cancel: ISO-8601 end, exclusive. With rule, the date the pattern stops. Required except cancel-by-source.

from.description: availability, required: ISO-8601 range start (naive = UTC).

to.description: availability, required: ISO-8601 range end, exclusive.

source.description: book/cancel: '<namespace>:<id>' — job:<invoice_id> binds it to the invoice (cancel by it undoes the job), subject:<contact_id> for a shift. A reference, never a name. Defaults to the op.

rule.description: book: RFC 5545 RRULE for a repeating reservation in one call, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SA,SU — days from the rule, hours from duration, from start until end.

duration.description: book: seconds per occurrence; required with rule (28800 = an 8-hour shift).
